title: Purple Mage Warrior
description: A young female character with white hair in buns stands in a dynamic combat pose against a solid gray background. She wears a white and purple traditional outfit with armor elements and wields swirling purple magical energy in both hands, one forming a circular spell and the other a crackling energy orb, with a glowing purple halo above her head.
prompt: A fierce young East Asian female mage with white hair tied in two buns and purple accents, wearing a detailed white and purple traditional fantasy outfit with armored shoulder pieces and a sash, stands in an action pose casting magic. She holds swirling purple arcane energy in both hands, one forming a circular rune and the other a chaotic energy burst, with a glowing purple halo of sparks above her head, solid gray background, dynamic anime-inspired digital art style.
